title: The First Wake · The Geometry of Becoming

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The emotional question is familiar, even when the novel’s language for it is radically strange.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Morrow shares a past with Rill, but has undergone transformations Rill has not experienced.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their common origin is called a Clutch, a shared history before separate identities emerge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A Molt changes a being deeply enough that its continuity must be examined again.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Elapsed time alone cannot describe the distance such changes create between two minds.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their reunion therefore carries more than an argument about unfamiliar machinery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks how we recognize someone whose experiences have changed what they value.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel lets that discomfort develop through a relationship, rather than resolving it with a definition.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed answer to costly coordination is a common rhythm called Onebeat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its appeal is concrete: fewer translations, easier exchanges, and more resources for continued existence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Processes that struggle to coordinate might gain something they urgently need.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But a shared measure can also become a requirement that every process must satisfy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The question is whether all these different lives fit the same description of progress.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a conflict between compelling pressures, rather than a simple dislike of clocks.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel gives you reasons to understand the attraction before asking you to examine its price.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The investigation keeps returning to the difference between describing someone and preserving them.
